", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0067", "tag": "p", "text": "Francis knew about the snakes of Central America merely by hearsay, but the hearsay was terrible enough. Small wonder she had fainted, was his thought, with so terribly rapid a poison doubtlessly beginning to work.
